claims: Dawn Staley is the head coach of the University of South Carolina women's basketball team.
Dawn Staley has held the position of head coach of the University of South Carolina women's basketball team since 2008.
The Gamecocks won three NCAA championships in 2017, 2022, and 2024.
Dawn Staley has been named National Coach of the Year five times in 2014, 2020, 2022, 2023, and 2024.
In 2021, Dawn Staley signed a seven-year, $22.4 million contract extension.
Before coaching, Dawn Staley was a Hall of Fame player.
Dawn Staley won three Olympic gold medals.
